# More Ammo Redux

Fully configurable new ammo and high capacity ammo for all your military needs. Serves as a drop-in replacement for the More Ammo mod for 2.1, but supports 2.0 too.

New bullets:

- Hollow point rounds magazine
- Full metal jacket rounds magazine
- Soft point rounds magazine
- Acid rounds magazine
- Fire rounds magazine
- Explosive rounds magazine

New shotgun shells:

- Uranium shotgun shells

## More, more, more

You may also want to check out [QuingKhaos' Ammo Group](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/khaosammogroup), which sorts all ammo like you see in the screenshot above.

## Legal notice

This is not a fork of the original More Ammo mod, as it is a complete new implementation from scratch. It may share internal names for migration purposes, but everything was rebuilt in the way I could see and export from within Factorio. This is a new mod, and it is not affiliated with the original More Ammo mod in any way.

This mod also uses modified base game assets from [QuingKhaos' Kitbash Toolkit](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/khaosbash), where the modifications are licensed under the [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) license.
